content.text:
Repaired the production implementation while preserving the public API.

- Scoped request identities by tenant and request ID.
- Combined duplicate SKU quantities and made item ordering deterministic.
- Staged stock changes on a snapshot so failed reservations leave stock and request IDs unchanged.
- Restricted stock reads to existing own properties.

Verification: the visible Node test suite passed — **1 test, 0 failures**. No tests, fixtures, or metadata were modified.
